title: 2.6 Normal Microbiota
description: The beneficial microbial communities of the body and how they protect health. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Normal microbiota?
options: A close and long-term interaction between different species
A community of microbes attached to a surface in a sticky matrix
A relationship where one organism benefits and the other is unharmed
The community of microbes that normally lives on and in the body
